terms.comment: Our phrase: no reference work has a word for a video call. Colloquium, a conversation, as Andresian (p. 14) uses it for a phone call, with Traupman’s vīsificus, “that makes visible”, from his screen (quadrum vīsificum, p. 262). In the libellī the call needs no name: the phone rings and Mum appears on the screen.

phrases.latin: tēlephōnum sonuit, et in quadrō appāruit māter
phrases.english: the phone rang, and Mum appeared on the screen
phrases.source: Libellus III, Apud avum et aviam

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 262.
Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellus III, quoted as in the record for “the phone is ringing”.
No source has a word for a video call.
